paragraphs.en: Empowerment measures the capacity of an agent to actively control its environment. In this work, we explain the connection between skill learning and empowerment. While skill learning is not empowerment, we introduce a simple scalable recipe for empowerment maximization: empowerment corresponds to the number of executable skills from a state, so maximizing empowerment corresponds to reaching states that are good starting points for many skills. Our recipe applies to arbitrary underlying skill learning methods. Whereas most prior work on empowerment looks at tabular settings, this recipe enables us to study empowerment at a scale where we can realize theoretically-predicted but empirically-elusive properties of empowerment (e.g., gathering resources, environment modification, survival). Experiments show that empowerment maximization unlocks interesting emergent properties, such as building a house in Crafter. 1 1 1 Website and code at https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/scaling-empowerment/ .

paragraphs.en: Empowerment , a measure of agency, has been speculated as a unified mathematical explanation for myriad properties of intelligent agents, ranging from building causal models ( Yiu et al.,, 2026 ; Abel et al.,, 2025 ; Lidayan et al.,, 2025 ) , acquiring resources ( Mohamed and Jimenez Rezende,, 2015 ) , maintaining homeostasis ( Klyubin et al.,, 2008 ; Salge et al., 2014b, ) , to explanations of how children explore ( Lidayan et al.,, 2025 ) . Prior work argues that empowerment should be especially important in open-ended environments, but does not maximize empowerment from scratch in such settings ( Song et al.,, 2026 ; Lidayan et al.,, 2025 ) . Despite decades of research studying the behavior of empowerment-maximizing agents, there has not yet been empirical demonstrations of algorithmic empowerment maximization in the “big world” ( Javed and Sutton,, 2024 ) – challenging, large settings where behaviors like survival and resource collection become tough. It is only in such tasks where we expect to see rich emergent behaviors from empowerment maximization.
paragraphs.zh: 赋能，作为自主性的一种衡量指标，已被推测为对智能体众多特性的统一数学解释，这些特性涵盖构建因果模型（Yiu 等，2026；Abel 等，2025；Lidayan 等，2025）、获取资源（Mohamed 和 Jimenez Rezende，2015）、维持稳态（Klyubin 等，2008；Salge 等，2014b），以及对儿童探索行为的解释（Lidayan 等，2025）。 先前的研究认为，赋能在开放环境中尤为重要，但并未在此类设定中从头开始最大化赋能（Song 等，2026；Lidayan 等，2025）。 尽管数十年的研究一直在探索最大化赋能的智能体的行为，但在“大世界”（Javed 和 Sutton，2024）——即生存和资源收集等行为变得极具挑战性的复杂大型环境中，尚未有对算法化赋能最大化的实证展示。 只有在这样的任务中，我们才有望观察到由赋能最大化所引发的丰富涌现行为。

paragraphs.en: Agents should successfully interact with an environment that they cannot fully describe. For example, even if a young child cannot fully explain all of the intricacies of a game like Minecraft, the child will still become empowered by defeating enemies and building a house, reaching an empowered state from which they know how to do many things. However, maximizing empowerment is a tricky computational problem. First, empowerment maximization requires solving for empowerment at particular contexts. If the context is a state, this means solving for empowerment in all of reachable state space. Second, solving for the empowerment at a particular context is a challenging problem and requires not only modeling the relationship between actions and outputs (e.g. a transition model), but also finding the actions that maximize control. While tractable using standard algorithms in tabular settings, the combination of these difficulties means canonical methods like Blahut-Arimoto cannot exactly solve this computational problem in high-dimensional settings. In the last decade, methods like VIM ( Mohamed and Jimenez Rezende,, 2015 ) , variational empowerment ( Karl et al.,, 2017 ) , and LatentGCE ( Zhao et al.,, 2021 ) aimed to address this computational problem using deep learning, and were the first to demonstrate learning-based empowerment maximization in simple tabular and continuous settings. However, there has not yet been a stable empowerment-maximization method that builds on the foundation of these works and scales to large continuous or discrete settings. This gap is important to resolve, given that large settings are precisely the right environments for empowerment maximization – where an agent must execute intelligent behavior despite having a limited view of a complex world.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体应当能够成功与一个它们无法完全描述的环境进行交互。 例如，即使年幼的孩子无法完全解释《我的世界》这类游戏的所有复杂细节，他们仍然会通过击败敌人和建造房屋获得能力增强，从而进入一种有能力完成许多事情的状态。 然而，最大化能力增强是一个具有挑战性的计算问题。 首先，最大化能力增强需要在特定情境下求解能力增强值。 如果该情境是一个状态，这意味着需要在所有可达的状态空间中求解能力增强值。 其次，在特定情境下求解能力增强值本身就是一个难题，不仅需要建模动作与输出之间的关系（例如转移模型），还需要找到能够最大化控制能力的动作。 尽管在表格化设置中可以通过标准算法解决，但这些困难叠加在一起意味着像 Blahut-Arimoto 这样的经典方法无法在高维设置中精确解决这一计算问题。 在过去十年中，诸如 VIM（Mohamed 和 Jimenez Rezende，2015）、变分能力增强（Karl 等人，2017）以及 LatentGCE（Zhao 等人，2021）等方法试图利用深度学习解决这一计算问题，并且首次展示了在简单的表格化和连续化设置中基于学习的能力增强最大化。 然而，目前尚未出现一种稳定的能力增强最大化方法，能够在这些研究的基础上进一步发展，并扩展到大规模的连续或离散设置中。 鉴于大规模设置恰恰是能力增强最大化的理想环境——智能体必须在这种复杂世界中尽管视野有限仍能执行智能行为——填补这一空白至关重要。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we scale empowerment maximization to a regime where theorized intelligent behaviors can emerge. Our starting point is the observation that empowerment maximization is closely related to unsupervised skill discovery (USD) methods. The goal of empowerment maximization is to reach states from which it is easy to reach a diverse set of states. Relatedly, USD methods aim to learn a diverse set of different “skills”. However, unlike prior empowerment-maximization methods that have struggled to scale, modern skill discovery methods can learn interpretable, diverse behaviors in continuous, high-dimensional tasks. As we will show, a particular class of USD methods called mutual information skill learning (MISL) measures the point-wise empowerment: at any particular state, the number of different skills an agent can execute from that state lower bounds its empowerment. In other words, an agent is empowered at states where it has many options, or skills. Thus, while skill learning methods do not directly learn policies that maximize empowerment, we can use scalable skill learning methods to estimate the empowerment of a particular state; we can then train another policy that ascends the empowerment landscape to get to states where it has many options.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们将赋能最大化扩展到一个能够产生理论化智能行为的机制。 我们的起点是这样一个观察：赋能最大化与无监督技能发现（USD）方法密切相关。 赋能最大化的目标是达到那些可以轻松进入多样化状态的状态。 与此相关的是，USD 方法旨在学习一组多样化的不同“技能”。 然而，与以往难以扩展的赋能最大化方法不同，现代的技能发现方法能够在连续的高维任务中学习可解释且多样化的行为。 正如我们将要展示的，一类名为互信息技能学习（MISL）的 USD 方法能够衡量点状赋能：在任何特定状态下，智能体可以执行的不同技能的数量为其赋能提供了一个下界。 换句话说，当智能体处于拥有多种选择或技能的州时，它就被赋予了赋能。 因此，尽管技能学习方法并不直接学习能够最大化赋能的策略，但我们仍可以利用可扩展的技能学习方法来估计特定状态的赋能；然后，我们可以训练另一个策略，使其沿着赋能景观上升，从而到达那些拥有多种选择的状态。

paragraphs.en: Our work has two key contributions. First , we provide a general recipe to convert scalable skill-learning methods into empowerment maximization methods and show our methods scale when baselines cannot. Second , we demonstrate our method in challenging, high-dimensional settings where empowerment-maximizing behavior becomes nontrivial, and analyze the behavior of empowered agents including resource gathering, survival, and environment modification. For example, early in training in Crafter, empowerment-maximizing agents learn to build houses at night when enemies appear and make and use tools. Our work shows that scalable empowerment maximization is possible, demonstrating interesting emergent behaviors in complex, open-ended setting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作有两个主要贡献。 首先，我们提供了一种通用方法，可将可扩展的技能学习方法转化为赋能最大化方法，并证明了当基线方法无法扩展时，我们的方法仍能扩展。 其次，我们在具有挑战性的高维环境中演示了我们的方法——在这些环境中，实现赋能最大化的行为变得非平凡，并分析了赋能智能体的行为，包括资源收集、生存和环境改造。 例如，在《Crafter》游戏的训练初期，实现赋能最大化的智能体学会了在夜间敌人出现时建造房屋，并制作和使用工具。 我们的工作表明，可扩展的赋能最大化是可行的，并在复杂、开放的环境中展示了有趣的涌现行为。

paragraphs.en: Intrinsic motivation enables exploration without external information about the Markov decision process (MDP) ( Gruaz et al.,, 2025 ) . Prior intrinsic motivation methods reward curiosity ( Pathak et al.,, 2017 ) , novelty ( Bellemare et al.,, 2016 ) , information gain ( Houthooft et al.,, 2016 ) , and prediction error ( Burda et al.,, 2019 ) . Empowerment instead rewards agency and control ( Mohamed and Jimenez Rezende,, 2015 ) , a motivation thought to explain human behavior and desired in complex, open-ended settings ( Gopnik,, 2024 ; Yiu et al.,, 2026 ; Dai and Gopnik,, 2025 ; Lidayan et al.,, 2025 ; Yang et al.,, 2026 ) . Prior works predicts that empowerment maximization should generate behaviors such as (1) environment modification ( Salge et al., 2014a, ) , (2) resource gathering ( Mohamed and Jimenez Rezende,, 2015 ) , and (3) survival. While these emergent behaviors have been previously demonstrated in simple experiments, we present scalable empirical evidence in large, open-ended settings.
paragraphs.zh: 内在动机无需关于马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的外部信息即可实现探索（Gruaz 等，2025）。 早期的内在动机方法奖励好奇心（Pathak 等，2017）、新颖性（Bellemare 等，2016）、信息增益（Houthooft 等，2016）和预测误差（Burda 等，2019）。 而“赋权”方法则奖励自主性和控制力（Mohamed 和 Jimenez Rezende，2015），这种动机被认为能够解释人类行为，并且在复杂、开放的环境中具有吸引力（Gopnik，2024；Yiu 等，2026；Dai 和 Gopnik，2025；Lidayan 等，2025；Yang 等，2026）。 早期研究预测，“赋权”最大化应能产生以下行为：（1）环境改造（Salge 等，2014a），（2）资源收集（Mohamed 和 Jimenez Rezende，2015），以及（3）生存。 尽管这些涌现行为已在简单实验中得到验证，但我们在此提供了在大型开放环境中可扩展的经验证据。

paragraphs.en: As originally introduced, empowerment quantifies the influence an agent’s open-loop actions can exert on future states ( Klyubin et al., 2005b, ; Salge et al., 2014b, ) . Two complementary forms of empowerment are useful ( Capdepuy,, 2011 ; Ji et al.,, 2026 ) . Potential empowerment measures the channel capacity between a sequence of actions and future observations conditioned on a starting state, measuring the maximal possible control from a particular context. In contrast, effective empowerment measures how many bits a particular distribution over open-loop controls communicates to the future. Potential empowerment is a scalar property of the context, while effective empowerment is also a function of the controls.
paragraphs.zh: 最初提出的赋能概念用于量化智能体的开环动作对未来状态所能施加的影响（Klyubin 等人，2005b；Salge 等人，2014b）。 两种互补的赋能形式具有实用价值（Capdepuy，2011；Ji 等人，2026）。 潜在赋能衡量的是在给定初始状态条件下，动作序列与未来观测之间的信道容量，即从特定情境中所能实现的最大控制能力。 相比之下，有效赋能衡量的是开环控制的特定分布向未来传递了多少比特信息。 潜在赋能是情境的一个标量属性，而有效赋能同时也是控制策略的函数。

paragraphs.en: VIM maximizes a variational lower bound on open-loop empowerment by learning a decoder that infers action sequences from policy outcomes ( Mohamed and Jimenez Rezende,, 2015 ) . Later empowerment maximization works like LatentGCE alternatively learn latent forward models to estimate the same empowerment, but relies on sufficient coverage over actions sequences in high-empowerment regions ( Zhao et al.,, 2021 ) . This requirement becomes increasingly demanding in higher-dimensional tasks. In contrast, we study closed-loop empowerment ( Gregor et al.,, 2017 ; Tiomkin et al.,, 2025 ) , which is the channel capacity of an information channel from a collection of closed-loop policies to outcomes. Thus, a state is empowering if an agent can execute a diverse repertoire of reactive policies from that state. This closed-loop formulation means empowerment measures what a standard reinforcement learning (RL) agent can actually do and naturally connects with unsupervised skill-discovery methods.

paragraphs.en: The MI maximized in MISL methods are related to closed-loop effective empowerment. Skills are not potential empowerment-maximizing policies, but they can provide estimates of the potential empowerment. Furthermore, while recent works have called attention to this relationship between skill-learning and empowerment ( Levy et al.,, 2025 ) , to our knowledge, there has not yet been work that exploits this connection to do scalable potential empowerment maximization. We close this gap by adapting modern MISL methods to maximize potential empowerment in large, open-ended settings.
paragraphs.zh: MISL 方法中最大化的 MI 与闭环有效赋能相关。 技能并非能够最大化赋能的潜在策略，但它们可以提供潜在赋能的估计值。 此外，尽管近期的研究已经关注到技能学习与赋能之间的这种关系（Levy 等人，2025），但据我们所知，目前还没有研究利用这种联系来实现可扩展的潜在赋能最大化。 我们通过将现代 MISL 方法加以调整，从而在大型、开放式的场景中最大化潜在赋能，以此填补了这一空白。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we introduce a scalable, online algorithm (SEE) to maximize empowerment (Eq. 1 ) by exploiting the connection between skill learning and empowerment. paragraphs.en: To test whether the method works in large, open-ended settings, we implement our method in Craftax-Classic ( Matthews et al.,, 2024 ) (JAX-accelerated Crafter, Fig. 1(d) ). Crafter is a large and partially observed setting with a 1345-dimensional symbolic observation and 17 discrete actions consisting of crafting, resource collection, fighting mobs, and eating/drinking. paragraphs.en: While MI is an important signal for training, achieving high MI does not guarantee meaningful empowerment maximization. In a continuous setting without constraints or significant noise, prior work has shown that trivial behaviors can realize potentially unbounded MI ( Ji et al.,, 2026 ) . Thus, we additionally track environment-specific metrics to judge the quality of the learned policies. In Ant, we measure the distance of the ant to the center of the arena. In AntSoccer, we measure the distance of the ant to the soccer ball. In BuilderBench, we measure the distance of the gripper to the cubes. In Crafter, we measure the achievement count. These external metrics measure the quality of learned behaviors independent of the MI quantities themselves.

paragraphs.en: SEE learns meaningful empowerment behavior in continuous settings that tracks increasing average empowerment estimates ( Fig. 8 ). If the empowerment is defined over all degrees-of-freedom (“Ant”), the policy π pot learns to navigate to the center region of the arena and stay there (white, Fig. 1(b) ) while the policies π eff branch and cover the space (colors, Fig. 1(b) ), following intuition that empowerment is high when the Ant can do more away from the walls of the arena. paragraphs.en: Resource-gathering and tool use enable empowerment-maximizing agents to exert control over the environment. sents.en: From that potentially-empowered state, the agent executes diverse skills such as building houses, mining, and using the gathered resources to craft new tools ( Fig. 5 ).
sents.zh: 从这种具备潜在赋能的状态出发，该智能体会执行建造房屋、采矿以及利用收集的资源制作新工具等多样化技能（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: Empowered agents learn to perturb their environment to maximize future control. This phenomena has been documented in prior works ( Salge et al., 2014a, ) in simple tabular settings. paragraphs.en: In death, an agent no longer has any control and, thus, has no empowerment. Therefore, agents maximizing empowerment should learn survival skills. In Crafter, we see that empowerment-maximizing agents naturally learn survival skills like killing and dodging enemies. Importantly, the empowerment-maximizing agent learns behavior distinct from simply training a survival reward (e.g. r = 1 r=1 for every step, r = 0 r=0 upon termination), which does not learn more complex crafting behaviors and only prioritizes survival skills.
paragraphs.zh: 在死亡状态下，智能体不再拥有任何控制权，因此也失去了赋能。 因此，追求最大赋能的智能体应当学习生存技能。 在《Crafter》中，我们看到追求最大赋能的智能体会自然地学习诸如击杀敌人和躲避敌人等生存技能。 重要的是，追求最大赋能的智能体所学习到的行为，与单纯训练生存奖励（例如，每一步 r = 1，终止时 r = 0）截然不同；后者无法学会更复杂的制造行为，只会优先关注生存技能。

paragraphs.en: Despite the conceptual appeal of empowerment as a tool for understanding natural agents and building artificial agents, its seeming computational intractability has caused prior work to resort to approximations that do not learn one policy that “keeps its options open” ( Klyubin et al.,, 2008 ) . In providing a conceptual link between skill learning methods and empowerment, we provide a method that maximizes potential and effective empowerment, two policies that measure controllability in distinct ways. We present key practical considerations to learn empowerment maximization policies in high-DoF settings. Future work should investigate simplified parameterizations of empowerment maximization that can resolve practical considerations detailed within our method, at scale. Furthermore, our work highlights the sensitivity of empowerment maximization to representations of the world, with open questions on the interplay between representations of the world and empowerment maximization ( Dai et al.,, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管将“赋能”视为理解自然智能体和构建人工智能体的工具在概念上颇具吸引力，但其看似难以计算的特性使得以往的研究不得不采用近似方法，而这些方法并未学习到一种能够“保持选择开放性”的策略（Klyubin 等人，2008）。 通过在技能学习方法与赋能之间建立概念性联系，我们提出了一种能够最大化潜在赋能和有效赋能的方法；这两种策略以不同方式衡量可控性。 我们提出了在高自由度设置中学习赋能最大化策略的关键实践考量。 未来的研究应探索赋能最大化的简化参数化形式，以便在大规模场景下解决本文方法中详述的实际问题。 此外，我们的工作凸显了赋能最大化对世界表征的敏感性，而世界表征与赋能最大化之间的相互作用仍是一个开放性问题（Dai 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: High MI does not directly imply interesting behavior in continuous settings . Prior works note that without any type of constraint on the information maximization problem, empowerment is ill-defined in continuous settings and can be infinite ( Salge et al., 2014b, ) . In our case, a fully-general skill decoder trained over the transitions can give arbitrarily large empowerment estimates, even for skills that barely change the state.
paragraphs.zh: 高信息最大化（MI）并不直接意味着在连续设置中会出现有趣的行为。 先前的研究指出，如果不对信息最大化问题施加任何类型的约束，那么在连续设置中，“赋能”这一概念将无法明确定义，甚至可能趋于无穷大（Salge 等人，2014b）。 在我们的研究中，一个基于状态转移训练的全通用技能解码器可能会给出任意大的“赋能”估计值，即使这些技能几乎不会改变状态。

paragraphs.en: The next baseline we consider is LatentGCE ( Zhao et al.,, 2021 ) . Unlike VIM , LatentGCE learns a generative, forward-in-time model to estimate empowerment. LatentGCE learns a latent model of the environment that is a linear Gaussian channel, which automatically gives a closed-form expression for the open-loop potential empowerment (under power constraints). This approach sidesteps the challenges of optimizing a source distribution by directly learning a generative model with a linear Gaussian form.
paragraphs.zh: 我们接下来要考察的基准方法是 LatentGCE（Zhao 等人，2021）。 与 VIM 不同，LatentGCE 学习一个生成性的、随时间正向演进的模型来估计赋能。 LatentGCE 学习环境的潜在模型，该模型是一个线性高斯信道，从而自动给出了开环潜在赋能（在功率约束下）的闭式表达式。 这种方法通过直接学习具有线性高斯形式的生成模型，绕过了优化源分布所面临的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Both methods estimate the empowerment over the same degrees of freedom as SEE: full state in Ant, ball in AntSoccer, and block positions in BuilderBench. In LatentGCE, we replace the convolutional encoders originally designed for the pixel-based settings with standard MLPs. Both methods optimize the potential empowerment policies using PPO . Since both methods estimate open-loop empowerment, we consider empowerment over open-loop action sequences of length H = 30 H=30 for VIM and H = 100 H=100 for LatentGCE. We chose a shorter sequence length for VIM due to the observed instability of the algorithm. We chose H = 100 H=100 for LatentGCE to match the effective trajectory length scale for the rollouts elsewhere in the paper, corresponding to a disount factor γ = 0.99 \gamma=0.99 . Tables 3 and 4 list the key hyperparameters, with full implementation provided in the linked code. In general, we find that VIM exhibits unstable training. In VIM, defining an energy for the source action sequence distribution with the learned decoders led to unstable source updates, which then negatively impacted future data collection. In earlier attempts at running LatentGCE, exponentiating the empowerment estimate produced large rewards ( Zhao et al.,, 2021 ) . Thus, we instead set the reward as the empowerment, following the released LatentGCE pseudocode and the methodology in the rest of this paper.

paragraphs.en: The crux of (most) modern MISL methods is to learn a classifier that identifies skills from states, transitions, or trajectories, then use that classifier as a reward. In expectation, the cumulative reward estimates/lower bounds an MI (see Sections 4.1 and A.1 ). Policies that maximize this MI become interpretable skills. In our method, we use the resulting MI estimate as a reward, training a potential empowerment policy where agents navigate to states where they have many options. We emphasize that this result is a modification of the result proved in Gregor et al., (2017) . We do not claim that this is a significant theoretical contribution, and include these results for completeness to show that, under assumptions, our method gives policy improvement. In practical settings with function approximation, these assumptions do not hold.
paragraphs.zh: （大多数）现代 MISL 方法的核心是学习一个分类器，该分类器能从状态、转换或轨迹中识别技能，然后将该分类器用作奖励。 在期望意义上，累积奖励对 MI 进行了估计/下界估计（参见第 4.1 节和 A.1 节）。 能够最大化此 MI 的策略将成为可解释的技能。 在我们的方法中，我们将得到的 MI 估计值用作奖励，训练一种潜在的赋能策略，使智能体导航至拥有多种选择的状态。 我们强调，这一结果是对 Gregor 等人（2017）所证明结果的修改。 我们不声称这是一项重要的理论贡献，但为求完整而将这些结果纳入其中，以表明在特定假设下，我们的方法能够改进策略。 在实际应用中，当使用函数近似时，这些假设并不成立。

paragraphs.en: Here, we prove that alternating (1) fitting an on-policy skill classifier and (2) running policy improvement using the trained classifier as a reward improves a lower bound on the potential empowerment. The result requires two preliminaries. The first preliminary is the Barber-Agakov bound ( Barber and Agakov,, 2003 ) which is a variational bound on MI that comes from the positivity of the Kullback-Liebler Divergence; we have already invoked this bound when introducing the classifier rewards.
